rows.abstract: Proposes the regulated exercise of the executive powers on creating appropriation reserves and suspendingexpen diture of appropriations. This proposal seeks to strike a balance between there two (2) legitimate concerns --- Left unchecked, these powers may cause delays in project implementation or allow the executive to alter established national priorities and reorganize programs approved by the legislature.

rows.title_full: AN ACT REQUIRING MOVIE, TELEVISION AND RADIO PRODUCERS, INCLUDING PROMOTIONS AND ADVERTISING AGENCIES, AND OTHER SIMILAR ENTITIES THAT EMPLOY UNEMANCIPATED MINORS, TO DEPOSIT THEIR TALENT FEES OR INCOME IN A TRUST FUND, PROVIDING PENALTIES FOR VIOLATIONS THEREFOR, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Movie, TV, radio producers, advertising agencies and talent promoters who hire the services of an unemancipated minor below 18 years of age are required to DEPOSIT in the NAME of the said MINOR at least FIFTY PERCENT (50%) of the minor's income/talent fee at a duly licensed bank in the form of a TRUST FUND.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on PUBLIC INFORMATION since 1998-11-09

rows.abstract: Proposes the following amendments to the Legal Education Board: (1) Allowing a former Dean of Law to seat in the Board, including two (2) active law practitioners, the DECS Secretary, the IBP President, the Philippine Association of Law Schools President, the Philippine Association of Law Professors President, and the President of the Association of Law Students in the Philippines. All members of the Board shall NOT receive any salary, except per diems.
